items.title: 14.1 Layers of the atmosphere (atmosphere ki layers) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.1 with Figure 14.1, printed page 306.

blocks.text: Atmosphere ki chaar alag layers (tahein) hain. Yeh layers is baat se pehchani jati hain ke oonchai (altitude) barhne ke saath temperature kaise badalta hai.
